description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Up to 50 crypto token prices in USD in one call from Chainlink Data Feeds read on-chain (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base): price, feed address, chain, oracle update time, block number. Unknown symbols listed in not_found. Returns JSON USD prices for up to 50 tokens, each with feed address, chain, oracle update time, and block, plus a not_found list.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tokens.description: Comma-separated token symbols, at most 50. Format: lowercase symbols separated by commas. Example: btc,eth,sol,link. Required.

vs.description: Quote currency. Format: a lowercase currency code. The existing schema description is usd. Example: usd.

name: prices
title: Bulk token prices, up to 50 per call ($0.003)
